title: Unifolio
tagline: Unifolio lets you view all the coins you own across all your wallets.
description:
==Inspiration==
I use several wallets. It is cumbersome to manually open them all one by one. Zerion doesn't support BTC or Solana. That's why I made this.

==What it does==
Add your wallet addresses in the app. It will fetch your balance for every wallet, every chain. Automatically.

==How we built it==
React + scanner integrations. Plus a lot of polish to remove rough edges.
how_its_made: I used Covalent apis to make this because they have information about all the chains. For frontend, I used React with TypeScript.
